name: Jharkhand State Data Centre (JHSDC), JAP-IT premises, Ranchi
notes: JAP-IT describes Jharkhand State Data Centre as common hosting infrastructure for state departments; MyGov Jharkhand's 24 June 2025 post says the state government operates JHSDC, and APMG lists ISO/IEC 20000 scope for provision of data centre and managed services from Ranchi.

name: Jharkhand State Data Centre 2.0 (JHSDC2.0), Ranchi
notes: GeM/JAP-IT procurement material identifies the Jharkhand State Data Center 2.0 project and tender JAPIT/JH-SDC 2.0/01/2023 dated 11 February 2023 for new IT equipment, software and licenses; mirrored RFP text describes expansion in the existing Ranchi JHSDC building.

name: Jharkhand Police Headquarters CCTNS / Special Branch data center, Dhurwa, Ranchi
notes: DCD reported a 16 September 2025 fire in the development room of the police data center at Jharkhand Police headquarters in Dhurwa, Ranchi; the room housed CCTNS, the in-house software team and Special Branch HRMS, confirming an operational government data-center function.

name: STPI Ranchi data center, Namkum Industrial Area
notes: 2016 reporting said STPI Ranchi was constructing a Tier-4-qualified 5,000 sq ft, 30-rack data center in Ranchi; STPI's 2025 Ranchi UPS battery tender and STPI Patna-Ranchi service pages show continuing operational infrastructure context, though current rack capacity is not publicly stated.

name: Sunshine Global Capital 10 MW AI Data Centre, Saraikela-Kharsawan cluster
notes: Jharkhand Chief Minister's Secretariat press release for investment proposals lists Sunshine Global Capital, Singapore for a 10 MW AI Data Centre associated with the Saraikela-Kharsawan steel, power and cement cluster; detailed site, schedule and power-interconnection information were not provided.
